column2:
The treacherous leader of the Miner's Union on Kwalasha - sentenced to death by electrocution - has repeatedly escaped custody through sheer luck or sabotage. Even with his latest recapture, carrying out his execution has hit a new snag.

The union leader’s transport shuttle has come down just beyond the walls of his final destination. As keepers of justice for the Federation, a detachment of the Mobile Infantry has arrived on scene and will swifty track down the elusive criminal.
Deliver Thomas Rees alive to the prison
Hold until the execution is completed

// NAME: // Note: Don't translate names starting with #

column2: Bug activity is on the increase.  Fleet has dropped supplies to build up your force.
It’s over. The prison is pacified.

// NAME: // ============== /OBJECTIVES/OBJECTIVE: CRUSH PRISONER REVOLT/TRIGGERS/FAIL: LOSE ALL UNITS ==============

column2: Shit, this operation is a complete Charlie Foxtrot. Mission failed.
Got an alert from prison security. Inmates broke out of their cells during the attack. It’s a full-scale revolt.
Great, now we got hostiles on both sides of the wall. How should we respond?
You’re authorized to use lethal force.
Control room secure. Cameras are back online.
We’re operating blind. Retake the control room, we can access the security system to get eyes on this place.
Those bug caves just keep brewing up trouble.  We've got to get out there and shut some of them down.
With Tanker Bugs around, we're going to need an extra punch.  We'll have to get a Rocket Depot up and running.
You’re watching a FedNet special event: The death of a traitor.
Thomas Rees betrayed humanity, and now he’ll pay the ultimate price.
His crimes: sedition, unionizing, spreading discontent.
Many were led astray by this criminal mastermind.
By sabotaging the war effort, he aided and abetted the bugs.
Kwalasha demands justice. This planet has no room for troublemakers.
If you’re not with the Federation, you’re with the bugs.
There it is – 2,000 volts of justice are now coursing through Rees’s body.  Justice has been served.

// NAME: // ============== /EVENTS/EVENTS: CAPTURE ZANDER/OBJECTIVE: FIND ZANDER/CRASH SITE/CHECK REACHED CRASH SITE ==============

column2: Hmm, they had a welcome party waiting for them.
They landed in one piece, but then the bugs got them. Now there are more pieces.
No sign of Rees, except for these tracks leading away from the crash. And the guards’ weapons are missing. These fugitives are armed.

// NAME: // ============== /EVENTS/EVENTS: CAPTURE ZANDER/OBJECTIVE: FIND ZANDER/INVESTIGATE TOWN/BUBBLES/BUGS ON ROAD KILLED ==============

column2: The fugitives were in a rush. These tracks are easy enough to follow, even without the trail of bodies.
We’re neck deep in bugs here.
Keep searching. FedNet viewers were promised an execution, and Command does not want to disappoint.
Copy that. The show must go on.

// NAME: // ============== /EVENTS/EVENTS: CAPTURE ZANDER/OBJECTIVE: FIND ZANDER/BATTLE WITH FUGITIVES/TRIGGERS/FUGITIVES DETECTED ==============

column2: We’ve spotted the fugitives. They’re holed up in a settlement ahead.
Only Rees matters - capture him alive. You’re authorized to neutralize anyone else who resists.
FedNet has an execution scheduled tonight, but the guest of honor has gone missing.
Prison transport shuttle sent out a mayday before we lost contact. Made an emergency landing not too far from here.
Our mission is to investigate the crash site and find the prisoners. If Rees’s still alive, he’s gonna fry on live TV.

// NAME: // ============== /EVENTS/EVENTS: CAPTURE ZANDER/OBJECTIVE: FIND ZANDER/FAIL: LOST ALL UNITS ==============

column2: Shit, this operation is a complete Charlie Foxtrot. Mission failed.

// NAME: // ============== /EVENTS/EVENTS: CAPTURE ZANDER/OBJECTIVE: BRING ZANDER TO THE PRISON/BRIEFING ==============

column2: We bagged Rees. He’s cooperating. I think he prefers us to the bugs.
Just in time. Deliver him to prison before the broadcast starts.

// NAME: // ============== /EVENTS/EVENTS: CAPTURE ZANDER/OBJECTIVE: BRING ZANDER TO THE PRISON/FAIL ==============
// ============== /EVENTS/EVENTS: WALL WAVE DEFENSE/OBJECTIVE: KEEP PRISON SECURED/VICTORY OR DEFEAT/FAIL: ALL LOST ==============

column2: We have lost control over the prison!

// NAME: // ============== /EVENTS/EVENTS: WALL WAVE DEFENSE/OBJECTIVE: KEEP PRISON SECURED/INTRO: EXECUTION BROADCAST ==============

column2: The prison guards will take custody of Rees. Not much time left, they’ll have to rush him through hair and makeup.
20 minutes til showtime. They’re broadcasting the execution live on all channels.
Think I’ll skip this one. I see enough death in the field.

// NAME: // ============== /EVENTS/EVENTS: WALL WAVE DEFENSE/OBJECTIVE: KEEP PRISON SECURED/BRIEFING ==============

column2: You’ve been assigned to prison defense. Keep that place locked down tight. Command doesn’t want anything interrupting the broadcast.

// NAME: // ============== /EVENTS/EVENTS: WALL WAVE DEFENSE/OBJECTIVE: DEFEAT FIRST WAVE/BRIEFING ==============

column2: Ok troopers, we’re prison guards for now! Get on those walls.
Proximity sensors lighting up. More bugs on the way.

column2: Bug attack wave on its way.  Get your teams ready.
Do not lose the prison Radio Station
